description: הערכת מחיר שרת רב-מוצרית ישירות ממחירון החנות. PURE CALCULATION (Stateless): Fast server-side price estimate from live WooCommerce pricelist for single product or multi-item cart (items[]). Does NOT create or persist a quote in the database. Use this when the user asks for pricing estimates, comparisons, or tier costs.

items.description: Multi-item lines array. Each item: {product_id, quantity, options: {color, branding, sleeve, sizes, variation_id}}

options.description: Optional product configuration options (color, branding, sleeve, sizes, variation_id)

product_id.description: TAGLI WooCommerce Product ID (for single-item requests; omit when using items[])

quantity.description: Requested package quantity (for single-item requests; omit when using items[])

name: agentic_estimate
title: Estimate Cart Pricing
